meta.summary: Expanded public-source inventory of Greater Melbourne commercial indoor play venues, play cafés and related family-entertainment venues. Includes named sites, unresolved regional launch signals and closed records. This is not a guaranteed census or live feed. One site is retained across old and new names.

coverage.name: Operator websites
coverage.note: 104 directory candidates cross-checked against operator links; 97 operator pages readable, supplemented with direct branch and booking pages.

coverage.name: Directories / local creators
coverage.note: 152 discovery entries screened; 104 relevant entries read individually. Regional Victoria, outdoor-only and general articles excluded. Current local visitor reports used to find omissions and rebrands.

coverage.name: Mall announcements
coverage.note: Westfield Knox, Fountain Gate and The Base Craigieburn pages checked for named arrivals and trading status.

coverage.name: Recruitment / registers
coverage.note: Branch-specific SEEK recruitment, Rainbow Town job syndication, ABN records and franchise listings cross-checked.

coverage.name: Planning / leasing
coverage.note: Cardinia, Knox and Casey-related traces retained. Indexed searches included growth-corridor councils; not every municipal register was enumerated.

coverage.name: Social media
coverage.note: Public LinkedIn evidence and creator reporting searched. Operator Facebook / Instagram account links retained. Blocked feeds and unviewed videos are explicitly labelled; TikTok was inaccessible.

coverage.name: Maps
coverage.note: Addresses cross-checked using operator pages and selected indexed map evidence. No full Google Maps crawl, authenticated review inspection or verified coordinate layer.

gaps: Unannounced private plans and non-indexed applications cannot be exhaustively discovered from these sources.
